Port Forwarding (WiFi Router)

You can test if your router allows automatic port forwarding via UPnP or configure it manually in the router web interface.

How to forward ports on your Router (Step by Step):

  1. Open a browser on your PC or phone and access your router (usually http://192.168.1.1 or http://192.168.0.1).
  2. Look for the section named Port Forwarding, Virtual Server or NAT.
  3. Add a rule for your Steam Deck's Local IP (192.168.x.x):
    External & Internal Port: 25565 • Protocol: TCP
  4. (Optional for Bedrock): Add a rule for port 19132 with protocol UDP.
  5. Save changes on the router. Your friends can now connect using your Public IP!

Secure Playit.gg Tunnel (Zero Router Setup)

With Playit.gg you don't need to forward router ports or expose your public IP. The agent creates a secure tunnel directly to Playit servers.

Don't have an account or tunnel? Sign up for free at playit.gg and create a tunnel for Minecraft (25565).

Remote SFTP / SSH Access (FileZilla / WinSCP)

Wirelessly transfer worlds, mods, datapacks and plugins from your main PC to the /servidor-mc directory on your Steam Deck.

URL for FileZilla / WinSCP (Local Network):
sftp://adminmc@192.168.1.100:2222

Anti-Desync Management & Reconciliation

If Podman reports corrupted states, storage locks, crashed containers or socket errors, this tool resets orphan states and restores clean pod synchronization.

Fix File Permissions

Runs the rootless routine podman unshare chown -R 0:0 and fixes read/write permissions on the worlds and data folder to avoid lockouts.

Steam Integration (Gaming Mode)

Installs shortcuts on your Desktop and SteamOS applications list so you can easily launch the app in Gaming Mode with controller support.
